Check the ring numbers and positive meas.en: Check the ring numbers and positive measured diameters in millimetres.
Check the ring numbers and positive meas.zh-CN: 请检查圆环编号，并输入以毫米为单位的正数实测直径。
Check the ring numbers and positive meas.zh-TW: 請檢查圓環編號，並輸入以毫米為單位的正數實測直徑。
Check the ring numbers and positive meas.ja: 円の番号を確認し、実測直径をミリメートルの正数で入力してください。
Check the ring numbers and positive meas.tr: Halka numaralarını kontrol edin ve ölçülen çapları milimetre cinsinden pozitif sayılarla girin.

Enter diameters for at least three rings.en: Enter diameters for at least three rings.
Enter diameters for at least three rings.zh-CN: 请至少输入三个圆环的直径。
Enter diameters for at least three rings.zh-TW: 請至少輸入三個圓環的直徑。
Enter diameters for at least three rings.ja: 少なくとも 3 本の円の直径を入力してください。
Enter diameters for at least three rings.tr: En az üç halkanın çapını girin.

Measure rings spanning at least half of.en: Measure rings spanning at least half of the recording progress, including inner and outer rings.
Measure rings spanning at least half of.zh-CN: 请测量覆盖至少一半记录进度的圆环，包括靠内和靠外的圆环。
Measure rings spanning at least half of.zh-TW: 請測量覆蓋至少一半記錄進度的圓環，包括靠內和靠外的圓環。
Measure rings spanning at least half of.ja: 内側と外側を含め、記録進行の半分以上を覆う円を測定してください。
Measure rings spanning at least half of.tr: İç ve dış halkalar dahil, kayıt ilerlemesinin en az yarısını kapsayan halkaları ölçün.

Measured diameters must increase from th.en: Measured diameters must increase from the innermost ring outward.
Measured diameters must increase from th.zh-CN: 实测直径必须从最内侧圆环向外递增。
Measured diameters must increase from th.zh-TW: 實測直徑必須從最內側圓環向外遞增。
Measured diameters must increase from th.ja: 実測直径は最も内側の円から外側へ増加する必要があります。
Measured diameters must increase from th.tr: Ölçülen çaplar en içteki halkadan dışa doğru artmalıdır.

These diameters do not define valid inne.en: These diameters do not define valid inner and outer radii. Check ring identities and measurements.
These diameters do not define valid inne.zh-CN: 这些直径无法确定有效的内外半径，请核对圆环编号和测量值。
These diameters do not define valid inne.zh-TW: 這些直徑無法確定有效的內外半徑，請核對圓環編號和測量值。
These diameters do not define valid inne.ja: これらの直径では有効な内外半径を求められません。円の対応と測定値を確認してください。
These diameters do not define valid inne.tr: Bu çaplar geçerli iç ve dış yarıçaplar tanımlamıyor. Halka eşleşmelerini ve ölçümleri kontrol edin.

Enter a diameter tolerance between 0.001.en: Enter a diameter tolerance between 0.001 and 2 mm.
Enter a diameter tolerance between 0.001.zh-CN: 请输入 0.001 至 2 mm 的直径容差。
Enter a diameter tolerance between 0.001.zh-TW: 請輸入 0.001 至 2 mm 的直徑容差。
Enter a diameter tolerance between 0.001.ja: 直径の許容差を 0.001 ～ 2 mm で入力してください。
Enter a diameter tolerance between 0.001.tr: 0.001 ile 2 mm arasında bir çap toleransı girin.

This target has no measurable circle pat.en: This target has no measurable circle pattern. Open the matching circle or original-cross record.
This target has no measurable circle pat.zh-CN: 此标靶没有可测量的圆环，请打开对应的圆环或原始十字标定记录。
This target has no measurable circle pat.zh-TW: 此標靶沒有可測量的圓環，請開啟對應的圓環或原始十字校準記錄。
This target has no measurable circle pat.ja: このターゲットには測定可能な円がありません。対応する円または元の十字の記録を開いてください。
This target has no measurable circle pat.tr: Bu hedefte ölçülebilir halka deseni yok. Eşleşen halka veya özgün artı kaydını açın.

Calibration circles.ja: キャリブレーション用の円

A diameter residual exceeds the toleranc.en: A diameter residual exceeds the tolerance. Check measurements and ring identities before applying.
A diameter residual exceeds the toleranc.zh-CN: 直径残差超过容差，请先核对测量值和圆环编号再应用。
A diameter residual exceeds the toleranc.zh-TW: 直徑殘差超過容差，請先核對測量值和圓環編號再套用。
A diameter residual exceeds the toleranc.ja: 直径の残差が許容差を超えています。適用前に測定値と円の対応を確認してください。
A diameter residual exceeds the toleranc.tr: Bir çap kalıntısı toleransı aşıyor. Uygulamadan önce ölçümleri ve halka eşleşmelerini kontrol edin.

Xaml.CircleCalibrationPattern.en: Use concentric circles for diameter calibration
Xaml.CircleCalibrationPattern.zh-CN: 使用同心圆进行直径标定
Xaml.CircleCalibrationPattern.zh-TW: 使用同心圓進行直徑校準
Xaml.CircleCalibrationPattern.ja: 直径のキャリブレーションに同心円を使用
Xaml.CircleCalibrationPattern.tr: Çap kalibrasyonu için eş merkezli halkalar kullan

Xaml.RingMeasurementHelp.en: Number complete circles from inside outward; do not count recording-area edges. Measure through the centre, from line centre to line centre. Enter at least three widely spaced circles; leave others blank. Use a decimal point.
Xaml.RingMeasurementHelp.zh-CN: 完整圆环由内向外编号，不计记录区边缘。穿过圆心测量直径，取两侧线条的中心位置。输入至少三个分布较广的圆环，未测的留空；使用小数点。
Xaml.RingMeasurementHelp.zh-TW: 完整圓環由內向外編號，不計記錄區邊緣。穿過圓心測量直徑，取兩側線條的中心位置。輸入至少三個分布較廣的圓環，未測的留空；使用小數點。
Xaml.RingMeasurementHelp.ja: 完全な円を内側から外側へ数え、記録領域の端は数えません。中心を通り、両側の線の中央間で直径を測定します。広い範囲の 3 本以上を入力し、未測定は空欄にします。小数点はピリオドです。
Xaml.RingMeasurementHelp.tr: Tam halkaları içten dışa numaralandırın; kayıt alanı kenarlarını saymayın. Çapı merkezden geçerek iki taraftaki çizgi ortaları arasında ölçün. Geniş bir aralıktaki en az üç halkayı girin, diğerlerini boş bırakın. Ondalık nokta kullanın.

Xaml.DiameterToleranceMm.tr: İzin verilen en büyük çap kalıntısı (mm)

Xaml.SolveRadiiFromCircles.ja: 円から内外半径を計算
Xaml.SolveRadiiFromCircles.tr: Halkalardan iç ve dış yarıçapları hesapla

Xaml.RingFitAccuracyHelp.en: Uses the saved track model; accuracy depends on your measurements. Pitch shape and angular alignment stay as recorded. Check the diameter residuals before applying.
Xaml.RingFitAccuracyHelp.zh-CN: 使用记录中保存的轨道模型，准确度取决于测量精度。轨距形状和角度对齐保持原记录值。请先检查直径残差。
Xaml.RingFitAccuracyHelp.zh-TW: 使用記錄中儲存的軌道模型，準確度取決於測量精度。軌距形狀和角度對齊維持原記錄值。請先檢查直徑殘差。
Xaml.RingFitAccuracyHelp.ja: 保存済みのトラックモデルを使用し、精度は測定に依存します。ピッチの形状と角度の位置合わせは記録時の値を保ちます。直径の残差を確認してください。
Xaml.RingFitAccuracyHelp.tr: Kaydedilen iz modeli kullanılır; doğruluk ölçümlere bağlıdır. İz aralığı şekli ve açısal hizalama kayıttaki gibi kalır. Önce çap kalıntılarını kontrol edin.
